data.name: vikas yadav
data.player_statement:
A complete player, vikas yadav has made a big mark in cricket. With 12 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 17, with an average of 4.57 and a quick strike rate of 60.38. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 1 sixes and 2 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 44.1 overs, taking 16 wickets at an economy rate of 6.70. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
